_comment: Every fact the agent is permitted to state lives in this file. A field left out is a question she will decline to answer rather than guess at, which is the correct behaviour — see edu/knowledge.py. Run `python -m edu.tools.prospectus_lint` after editing.
name: XYZ International School
curriculum: CBSE, from Nursery to Grade 12, with Science and Commerce streams in Grades 11 and 12

eligibility.Nursery: Child must be 3 years old as on 31 March 2026
eligibility.Grades 2 to 8: Transfer certificate from the previous school and a report card for the last academic year
eligibility.Grade 9: Written assessment in English, Maths and Science
eligibility.Grade 11: Minimum 60 percent in Grade 10 for Science, 50 percent for Commerce

fee_structure.Nursery to UKG: Rupees 78,000 per year, including books and uniform
fee_structure.Grade 1 to Grade 5: Rupees 92,000 per year, including books and uniform
fee_structure.One-time admission fee: Rupees 25,000, payable once at the time of admission
fee_structure.Payment: Payable in two instalments, in April and October

admission_process: Register online or at the school office and pay the registration fee of rupees 1,500
Submit the completed form along with the required documents
Attend the interaction or written assessment, depending on the grade
Receive the outcome within seven working days
Confirm the seat by paying the admission fee within ten days of the offer
documents_required: Transfer certificate from the previous school, for Grade 1 and above
Report card for the last academic year
entrance_test: Written assessment for Grade 9 and above only. Held on the second and fourth Saturday of each month at 10 am. Nursery to Grade 8 have an informal interaction with the child and parents instead, with no preparation needed.
timings: Nursery to UKG: 9 am to 12.30 pm. Grade 1 to Grade 5: 8.15 am to 2.45 pm. Grade 6 to Grade 12: 8 am to 3.30 pm. Saturdays are working for Grade 9 and above only.
transport: School buses cover Kothrud, Baner, Aundh, Wakad, Hinjewadi, Bavdhan and Pashan. Fees range from rupees 8,000 to rupees 12,000 per year depending on distance. Each bus has a female attendant and GPS tracking.
hostel: No hostel. XYZ International is a day school only.
student_teacher_ratio: 28 students per section is the maximum; the average across sections is 25. Two teachers per section up to Grade 2.
facilities: Two hundred metre track and a football field
Medical room with a full-time nurse
activities: Annual residential trip from Grade 5 upwards
campus_visit: Campus visits run every Saturday between 10 am and 1 pm, and on weekdays by appointment. A visit takes about forty-five minutes and includes the classrooms, laboratories and playing fields.
scholarships: Merit scholarships are available for Grade 11 admissions based on Grade 10 results. A counsellor discusses eligibility individually; the agent does not quote amounts.
_catchment_aliases_comment: Local-script spellings, including the ones people actually type and say. Without these the locality slot never fills on a Hindi or Marathi call, because a Devanagari transcript shares no characters with the Latin list above.

contact.Admissions office: 020 2345 6789, between 9 am and 4 pm on working days

prohibited_claims: Never say a seat is reserved, held, or guaranteed for anyone. Only the admissions office confirms a seat.
Never quote a scholarship amount or a fee concession.
Never compare XYZ International with any other named school.
Never claim a board result, ranking or placement figure that is not listed in these facts.
Never say seats are limited or filling fast.

faqs.q: Is there an interview for the parents?
faqs.a: For Nursery through Grade 8 there is an informal interaction with both the child and the parents. It is a conversation, not a test, and nothing needs to be prepared.

faqs.q: What is the medium of instruction?
faqs.a: English. Hindi is taught from Grade 1 and Marathi from Grade 3, both as second and third languages.
Mid-year admission is possible up to Grade 8 if a seat is available in that section, subject to a transfer certificate.
